heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Custom ERP or off-the-shelf?
items.answer: Custom ERP fits unusual workflows exactly. We help you compare cost and fit before deciding.

items.question: Can you integrate with MYOB or other accounting tools?
items.answer: Yes. We have built integrations with accounting platforms such as MYOB.

items.question: Can we start with a few modules?
items.answer: Yes. A phased rollout reduces risk and speeds up value.

items.question: How long does erp development take?
items.answer: A focused system can go live in 8 to 12 weeks, while larger multi-department platforms take 4 to 9 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
